examples.description:
KrackSocial is FREE social network for anyone 18 and older! It's available on your Android phone, computer, as well as through your iPhone or iPod Touch (using the web browser).

Partial Feature List:

- Send private messages to other members. You can delete sent and received messages and create folders to keep messages in.

- Complete profiles. Fill out as little or as much as you like. Upload a profile picture and as many album pictures as you want. Privacy settings who can see your profile, contact you, view your pictures, and more.

- Find out who's near you with the local people search (app is new so you probably won't find many yet).

- Flirt with other members by poking them, sending them profile gifts, and more.

- Rate pictures. Easy 5 star rating system.

- Create your own polls and vote/comment on others.

- Embed pictures any where. Change your text color, text size, and more. This app supports most BBCode just about every place in the app where you can type.

- Create your own group, which includes a wall and forum. Participate in groups created by other members.

- Join a crew, or create your own. You can only join one and they're private just to those who have joined them. You don't have to join any.

- Buy your friends and work your way up the leaderboard and top 5 lists in this game.

- Join chat. This will become more fun as more people join so tell your friends about the app! Show it to them at school.

- Switch between light and dark themes. Light theme makes the site easy to read. Dark brings out even more fun, such as changing your text color that everyone sees when you write something.

- Tons more features like: see who's been viewing your profile, see who's been viewing your pictures, hide yourself from showing up online, create chat commands, create new pokes, earn trophies, make members do what you want them to do to get your trophies, and much much more.

NO other app comes even close to this one. This is a social app like myYearbook, Mocospace, Myspace, Facebook, etc, but with a lot more things to do.

Note: Please report app problems to help@kracksocial.com rather than posting it in your review. It would be much easier to resolve it that way.

Also Note: This site has absolutely nothing to do with illegal drugs. They are not endorsed in any way. The site is addicting.

examples.description:
Smartr Contacts (by Xobni) makes all the people you've ever exchanged emails, calls or SMS' with, instantly searchable from your Android phone.

Smartr Contacts makes you smarter about your network.

It's an easy-to-use, free app that automatically finds all the people you've exchanged emails, SMS' or calls with and creates rich profiles for them even if they are not in your address book. Discover who they are, how you know them, when you last talked, and who you have in common. See photo, job title, company details, and updates from LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter automatically and effortlessly.

Smartr Contacts makes it easy to get to know new contacts, establish relationships with existing contacts, and grow your network.

??????????????? FEATURES ???????????????
- Automatic. Finds all the people you know from your email, call, SMS or calendar history
- Personal. Puts a face to every name and email address
- Insightful. Detects and assigns phone numbers from email exchanges and Google Contacts
- Socially aware. Integrates Facebook, LinkedIn and Twitter
- Relevant. Ranks contacts by importance
- Convenient. Widgets make it easy to search your contacts from the home screen.
- Complete. Includes recent emails, calls, calendar events and SMS messages.
- Timely. Includes calendar events for each person and photos for all the attendees
- Integrated. Easily compose emails to multiple contacts with a single click
- Smart. When composing messages, it recommends the people you frequently email with each contact
- Fast. Search by first, last, company name or phone number to find anyone.
- Intriguing. View relationship history - when you met, how many messages you've exchanged and more
- Resourceful. Mutual contacts helps you answer the question "What's the name of the person I met in the meeting with Joe?"

Get Pro to connect all your contacts across Gmail, Android, Outlook, BlackBerry and iPhone (coming soon)

??????????????? Ways that you can use Smartr for your personal and professional life ???????????????
- Keep track of all the people you've ever communicated with - automatically
- Call, email or SMS someone with a single tap
- Never leave anyone off an email - AutoSuggest helps you remember people you usually email together
- Stay up to date with updates from Facebook, LinkedIn and Twitter
- See contacts you have in common
- Find out when you first met someone, who introduced you and how many emails you've exchanged
- View the last email you exchanged with anyone
- Find the contact info for someone you've never emailed with common contacts
- Bring all your contacts from Android, BlackBerry, Gmail and Outlook together into one place
- Protect your contacts in the cloud, so should you lose your phone, all your contacts are safe and secure

??????????????? Requirements ???????????????

- A Xobni account is required to use this app.
- Either Gmail or Xobni for Outlook is required for Smartr Contacts for Android to work properly.

??????????????? We???re here to help ???????????????

- Learn more about Smartr Contacts for Android: http://www.xobni.com/android
- You can also use Smartr in Gmail - Check out Smartr Inbox for Gmail: http://www.xobni.com/download/gmail
- Visit the forum: https://support.xobni.com/categories/12225-xobni-for-android-private-alpha#
- Email Support: androidsupport@xobni.com
